HERO.DESCRIPTION: Business Administration and Systems Engineering student. From Colombia. I like to offer solutions through technology.

ABOUT.TITLE: About me
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH1: I am a student at San Buenaventura University in Cali, where I began my studies in Business Administration in the second semester of 2021. In the second semester of 2022, I decided to broaden my academic horizons by opting for a double degree in Systems Engineering. This decision has given me an integral perspective, combining business logic with the use of computer tools for effective problem solving.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH2: My academic background has allowed me to develop skills in programming, as well as in strategic decision making and resource management. My goal is to integrate my technical and business knowledge to contribute to the development of innovative solutions in the field of technology.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH3: My favorite programming language is Python, with which I have the most experience. In addition, I have knowledge in JavaScript, C++ and Java, and I have solved problems with these languages. I have also worked with web frameworks such as Astro, Django and Angular, which has allowed me to develop robust and efficient applications.

PROYECTS.TITLE: Projects
PROYECTS.DESCRIPTION: These are some of the projects I have developed
PROYECTS.NEUROSCREEN_DESCRIPTION: Desarrollada en Flask, NeuroScreen es una aplicación web que permite la detección temprana de trastornos por consumo de alcohol mediante el análisis de datos EEG y machine learning. La aplicación ofrece funcionalidades como autenticación de usuarios, gestión de pacientes, carga de archivos EEG para predicciones en tiempo real, y un dashboard con visualización de interpretabilidad.
PROYECTS.NEUROSCREEN_SUBTITLE: Detección temprana de alcoholismo mediante análisis EEG y machine learning
PROYECTS.NEUROSCREEN_PROBLEM: Necesidad de herramientas clínicas accesibles para detección temprana de trastornos por consumo de alcohol usando biomarcadores neurológicos.
NEUROSCREEN_FEATURES: Login/Logout con JWT y persistencia de sesión
CRUD de pacientes y gestión de usuarios
Carga de archivos EEG y predicciones en tiempo real
Responsive design con indicadores de carga
PROYECTS.LEETCODE_CLONE_SUBTITLE: Plataforma de ejercicios de programación inspirada en LeetCode
PROYECTS.LEETCODE_CLONE_PROBLEM: Crear un entorno local de práctica de algoritmos con editor de código y evaluación automática de soluciones.
LEETCODE_CLONE_FEATURES: Lista de ejercicios con páginas individuales
Editor de código con submit y evaluación automática
PROYECTS.CALINEMA_DESCRIPTION: Developed in Astro, CaliNema is the prototype website that displays all the movies and showtimes available in the cinemas of Cali city for the day. The movie information is obtained by the CaliNema API.
PROYECTS.CALINEMA_API_DESCRIPTION: Developed in Django REST Framework, the CaliNema API scrapes the pages of the five cinemas in the city of Cali to obtain all the movies and showtimes for the day the scraping is performed.
PROYECTS.POKEDEX_DESCRIPTION: A web application developed with Vite and React that uses the PokéAPI to display detailed information about various Pokémon. It integrates React Three Fiber to render 3D models and elements, providing a dynamic and interactive visual experience.
PROYECTS.RADIOAPP_DESCRIPTION: A web application built with Vite and React that uses the Radio Browser public API to display radio stations from around the world. The homepage highlights stations from Colombia, providing a simple interface for exploring and playing live content.
PROYECTS.LEETCODE_CLONE_DESCRIPTION: A web application for testing exercises, built using Flask and inspired by LeetCode. It allows users to solve programming problems, submit solutions, and view their results.
PROYECTS.XRAYS_DESCRIPTION: Repository containing a machine learning project focused on the automatic classification of chest X-rays using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transfer learning models (VGG16 and ResNet50).
PROYECTS.MENUUSB_DESCRIPTION: Developed in Django, MenuUsb is the prototype website that displays all the menus of the San Buenaventura University stores in one place.
PROYECTS.DEMOCRACIA_ELITE_DESCRIPTION: Website developed for a constitution and democracy assignment. The site describes, gives characteristics, and provides examples of what elite democracy is.
